purpose.zh: 让髋部在最大范围内慢慢转动，更灵活
purpose.en: Move your hip slowly through its biggest range to keep it mobile.

text.zh: 膝盖抬起，画一个你能做到的最大的圈
text.en: Lift your knee and draw the biggest circle you can

text.zh: 屁股和背不动，只有腿在转。
text.en: Keep your hips and back still; only the leg moves.

text.zh: 往前、往外、往后画一圈，下一圈反方向。
text.en: Circle forward, out and back, then go the other way next time.

commonErrors.en: Turning the hips with the leg.

cautions.zh: 髋部不舒服时幅度小一点，还疼就停
cautions.en: If your hip feels uncomfortable, move less far, and stop if it still hurts.

cautions.zh: 手腕刺痛或发麻时停止，开始前先活动手腕
cautions.en: Stop if your wrists feel sharp pain or numbness, and warm them up first.

changes: 名字「四足」「CARs」难懂，改「跪撑髋部画圈 / Hands-and-Knees Hip Circles」
动画 8 s 内一圈正向（0.5–3.9 s）+ 一圈反向（4.3–7.7 s）；派生 lift 轨只看抬膝高度（go1.7/back0.5 不对），按 spec 注释手算：一圈 = 1 次，前半圈 1.7、后半圈 1.7、停 0.6 → rep_cycle
剂量 3 次改为每侧 6 圈（正反各 3）
flags: 相位为手算（非批表）；一圈算 1 次、正反交替，请确认
